title: Average
statement: Implement `solve(nums)`. Return the integer average of a non-empty list, using floor division by the length. An empty list returns `error`.
hints: Reject an empty list before dividing.
Sum and divide by the length.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The average of an empty sample is undefined, not zero.

editorial: The average of an empty sample is undefined, not zero. Checking the length is the narrowing step a type checker cannot do for you if the list is merely list[int]. Floor division keeps the result an integer the judge can compare exactly.
